hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: QFAI user questions (.agents/rules/user-questions.md). Every question you put to the user this turn goes through the host's structured question tool where it is callable, and through that rule's fallback where it is not — carrying the same parts either way. No question is light enough to skip it: a yes-or-no, a confirmation and a "just checking" are each a question. Read the rule rather than working from this line.

QFAI documentation clarity (.agents/rules/documentation-clarity.md). Before this title or body ships: no issue or PR numbers, ticket IDs or team-local jargon in source and docs; no account of how the work went, only the current behaviour and why; cut self-evident, repeated and wordy text; ordinary words, one claim per sentence, short lines; bullet lists and tables for parallel items; then re-read every line and rewrite anything that reads as a literal translation.

QFAI grilling (.agents/rules/grilling.md). Before this: is a decision about to be fixed that the repository cannot settle — a design, an approach, a scope boundary, a trade-off? If so, that rule governs how it is put, and an agent that answers it alone has stopped following it. Read the rule rather than working from this line: the method has parts a reminder cannot carry without contradicting them.

QFAI minimal implementation (.agents/rules/minimal-implementation.md). For the file just changed, if it is source: could it not exist at all, is it already in this codebase, or does the standard library, the platform or an already-installed dependency do it? Otherwise the least code that works. Mark a deliberate shortcut with both its ceiling and the condition that lifts it. The ladder never removes what § 2 of that rule lists. For a change to a screen or to terminal output, .agents/rules/interface-clarity.md governs what may appear.
